limitations: The logarithmic discrepancy error is not claimed optimal.
The theorem is a weak empirical limiting law, not an exact finite-index closed form.
The 2020 Shallit rank-19 linear representation already computes the full pointwise count; the newly assessed content is the explicit simple phase law and its atom.
Full text of certain 2021/2022 related sumset papers was unavailable in this comparison; an implicit older treatment remains possible.
scientific_integrity: Analytic continued-fraction and rotation-count proof; exact finite reproducibility checks are supplementary. Self-review only; no independent audit or external validation.
title: A phase law and an atomic limiting distribution for mixed Wythoff representations
